name: agent-task
description: One agent does one piece of work for the active company: Octa writes an RCCF brief, the agent drafts, and the owner approves the result before it counts.
acceptance: The agent stayed inside its job and met its Definition of Done.
Nothing was sent, published, paid or deleted; the owner approved or rejected the draft.

steps.name: RCCF brief
steps.prompt: Octa writes the Role / Context / Command / Format brief for the agent from its identity, job, Definition of Done, the company's master prompt and the owner's task.
acceptance: out/brief.md states the role, context, command and format.

steps.name: Agent does the work
steps.prompt: The agent executes the RCCF brief and drafts its deliverable into out/.
acceptance: The deliverable meets the agent's Definition of Done and passed the 3-point QA.
